_comment: All tunable game numbers. A plain number is a confirmed rule from CLAUDE.md. An object with "placeholder": true, or with "status": "placeholder" (health block), is a temporary value that is not decided yet; read it through Config.get_value(), which returns its "value".

first_day_start_hour.comment: Clock time (24 h) when the first day starts.

max_sleep_hours.comment: Maximum hours on the sleep slider.

max_frame_seconds.comment: Longest real time counted in one frame, so a frozen or hidden tab cannot jump game time forward.

daylight._comment: Only how the sky looks. Being awake or asleep follows the time rules above, not these hours.

twilight_hours.comment: Length of dawn and dusk, centred on start_hour and end_hour, when the sky fades between day and night.

autosave_real_seconds.comment: Extra safety save every this many real seconds while the game is open.

resume_paused.comment: If true, a day in progress is paused when the game is reopened, so time only starts when the player presses pause again.

debug._comment: Only works when the game runs from the Godot editor. Press F9 to change the speed. Never active in the published build.

measures._comment: The starting physical, mental and sleep measures and the body states come from the chosen difficulty (health.difficulties).

calories_spent_start.comment: Total kcal spent by exercise so far. Whether it resets each day is not decided.

slider_min_hours.comment: Smallest value on the sleep slider. The largest is time.max_sleep_hours.

slider_default_hours.comment: Where the slider starts. 10 h is the baseline sleep.

health._comment: Every value of the health calculation (CLAUDE.md, Health calculation; MILESTONE_4.md has the key names). Each value has a status (placeholder, team decision or from source) and an owner (Pessoa 1 to 4, as in the research plan). Changing a value here changes the game without any code change; in debug builds press F6 to reload this file while the game runs. Keys marked "Milestone 3 rule" are still used by the old formulas and are removed when Milestone 4 replaces those formulas.

k.comment: Body speed multiplier: how much faster health and the body change than the real-life average. Same k for habits.

death_enabled.comment: There is no death, only failure.

habit_days_to_95.comment: Real days for a habit to reach 95% of its usual level (Lally and colleagues 2010, median).

habit_share_reached.comment: The share of a new habit that is reached after habit_days_to_95 real days.

habit_cost._comment: Team model for the cost of changing habits (built in Milestone 4 Task 5). D = max(0, |A - H| - T); P = min(P_max, alpha * R^gamma * D^gamma).

T.comment: Tolerance: changes smaller than this cost nothing.

alpha.comment: Penalty intensity. Not the same as alpha_bar.

P_max.comment: Maximum mental penalty per avatar day, in points of the 0 to 100 mood scale.

lambda.comment: Speed at which rootedness R grows, per real day.

score_window.comment: One scoring day = from one wake-up to the next. Open team decision.

k_applies_to_sleep_debt.comment: Open team decision. False: sleep debt changes once per avatar day.

child.comment: CDC / AASM, 6 to 12 years. Hours per 24 h.

teenager.comment: CDC / AASM, 13 to 18 years. MILESTONE_4.md calls it teen; the game saves the age group as teenager.

child.comment: Midpoint of the range: one number for the sleep debt formula.

sleep_zero_at.comment: Sleep score 0 at this many hours or less, linear up to the lower limit of the range.

sleep_over_penalty_per_h.comment: Sleep score lost per hour above the upper limit.

r.comment: Share of the sleep debt kept each day: it halves in about 3 days without new debt (0.8^3 = 0.51).

debt_max.comment: Sleep measure = sleep score x (1 - debt / debt_max), never below 0. Hours.

screens_full_until_h.comment: Australian guidelines: 2 h of recreational screens per day. Screen score is 1 up to this.

screens_zero_at_h.comment: Screen score falls in a straight line to 0 here. A game choice.

enjoyment_full_at_h.comment: Enjoyment score e = entertainment hours / this, at most 1.

mood_speed.comment: Mood moves this share of the way to its target per avatar day. Not multiplied by k.

fitness_k_down.comment: Per real day. 21% VO2max loss after 6 weeks without training (young footballers).

fitness_k_up.comment: Per real day. Same as k_down until a source is found.

muscle_k_up.comment: Per real day. Same as fitness until a source is found.

muscle_k_down.comment: Per real day. Same as fitness until a source is found.

weight_score._comment: 1 while the WHO BMI-for-age z-score is between -full_within_z and +full_within_z, and falls to 0 at +-zero_at_z along t^curve_power, where t goes in a straight line from 1 to 0. MILESTONE_4.md says linear (curve_power 1); the user chose to keep the t^2 curve so the starting fitness stays in order from Easy to Very hard.

curve_power.comment: 1 = straight line. Kept at 2 by the user.

combine._comment: C = (w_P*P^p + w_M*M^p + w_S*S^p)^(1/p), weights divided by their sum. Target health = health_min + (health_max - health_min) x C = 1 + 4C.

p.comment: Calibration. Between the ordinary (1) and the geometric (0) mean.

alpha_bar.comment: Health bar speed: 90% of the way to the target in 5 avatar days ((1 - 0.37)^5 = 0.1). Not the same as habit_cost.alpha.

log._comment: Action log. The types are the activity option ids in data/activities.json.

screen_types.comment: All entertainment counts as recreational screen time until sedentary and active entertainment exist.

milestone3_rules._comment: Milestone 3 rules still in use. Milestone 4 Task 5 replaces them with habit_cost and the enjoyment score, and then they are deleted.

difficulties._comment: Starting values per difficulty. physical, mental and sleep are the starting measures; starting health is calculated from them, never typed in. weight_z is the WHO BMI-for-age z-score and stays fixed until food exists. The body states are chosen so that on day 1 they give the starting measures: (fitness + muscle + weight score) / 3 = physical, mood = mental, sleep_debt = 0. start_R is the starting rootedness of the habits (low on Hard = cheap habit changes, high on Very hard). habit_change_cost and usual_habits (as habit scores) are Milestone 3 rules, replaced in Milestone 4 Tasks 4 and 5.

hard.comment: Health about 2. Habit changes are cheap.

very_hard.comment: Health about 1.3, shown as level 1. Changing habits fast is expensive.

xp._comment: Health level = health rounded to the nearest whole number (1 to 5). XP never goes below 0; the level is XP divided by per_level, so losing XP can also lower the level.

per_level.comment: XP needed to fill the bar once (one level).

per_health_point.comment: XP gained when health rises by 1 point, and lost when it falls by 1 point (in proportion for smaller changes).

gain_per_avatar_hour.comment: Base XP gained per avatar hour while the health level is at or above high_health_min.

high_health_bonus_per_hour.comment: Staying at high health for longer gives more: the hourly gain is multiplied by 1 + this x hours spent at high health without a break.

high_health_max_multiplier.comment: Largest multiplier for the hourly gain at high health.

loss_per_avatar_hour.comment: XP lost per avatar hour while the health level is at or below low_health_max.

hungry_hunger.comment: Hunger at or above this shows the hungry state.

sad_mental.comment: Mental at or below this shows the sad state.

ill_health.comment: Health at or below this shows the ill state.

language.comment: Starting language until settings exist. pt or en.

avatar_name.comment: Set on the avatar creation screen.

age_group.comment: Used for the recommended sleep before the player chooses an age group.

difficulty.comment: Starting values used before the player chooses a difficulty.

name_max_length.comment: Most characters allowed in the avatar's name.
